headline: Fort Lewis end CSU Pueblo's unbeaten season
dek: CSU Pueblo had won thirteen and drawn three without defeat, and had beaten Fort Lewis in both earlier meetings, before losing to them at home. Regis, held goalless by Westminster the same night, meet Fort Lewis next.
displaced_by: CSU Pueblo lost at home to Fort Lewis, and Regis drew with Westminster; the standing lines called CSU Pueblo unbeaten and Regis winning every match.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: South Dakota Mines have scored more goals than Colorado School of Mines and Adams State together, but have also conceded 30; scoring is not what separates the top of the table.

wire.line: Fort Lewis won at CSU Pueblo, and no side in the conference is unbeaten any longer.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Nine matches have passed their date with no result published, the earliest from the season's opening day; none is a score gap.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Colorado School of Mines have yet to win this season, with three draws and fifteen defeats, the latest at home to Regis.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Adams State have scored eight goals this season and conceded 50.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: CSU Pueblo's Nick Cenek has eleven goals and four assists this season, from 57 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: UCCS's Hugo Sjöberg has made 68 saves this season and conceded nineteen goals.

last_match.line: CSU Pueblo had won both earlier meetings this season and had lost to nobody until this one.

next_match.line: Regis won at Fort Lewis in October; Fort Lewis arrive having handed CSU Pueblo their only defeat.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
